name: context-rollover
description: Rolls long-running (multi-agent) Claude Code work over into fresh sessions before the context gets too large: persists a compact, verified continuation of the project state, starts a genuinely fresh session and resumes the highest-priority work. Publishes its lifecycle as shared state for the Cockpit sidebar.

enabled.title: Enabled
enabled.description: Monitor context usage and roll over automatically.

softLimit.title: Soft limit (tokens)
softLimit.description: Context tokens at which the rollover starts preparing: the model is told and state is gathered.

prepareLimit.title: Prepare limit (tokens)
prepareLimit.description: Context tokens at which a draft continuation is saved, new agents are held, and the session rolls over at the next turn end.

hardLimit.title: Hard limit (tokens)
hardLimit.description: Context tokens at which new main-loop work is refused and the turn is wound down so the rollover happens now. Clamped to 90% of the model's window when that is smaller.

automaticRestart.title: Automatic restart
automaticRestart.description: Start the fresh session without asking. Off: persist the continuation, then wait for you to run /clear.

restartMode.title: Restart mode
restartMode.description: clear: /clear in this terminal (same process, new session id, empty conversation). new-terminal: open a new terminal running claude, then exit this one.

continuationDir.title: Continuation folder
continuationDir.description: Where continuations are kept. Empty: ~/.claude/context-rollover/<project>. A relative path is under the project.

maxContinuationTokens.title: Continuation size limit (tokens)
maxContinuationTokens.description: The continuation is trimmed, lowest-priority sections first, to fit this.

rolloverTimeoutMs.title: Rollover timeout (ms)
rolloverTimeoutMs.description: An attempt that takes longer is abandoned and retried.

maxRetries.title: Retries
maxRetries.description: How many times a failed attempt is retried (with exponential backoff).

retryDelayMs.title: Retry delay (ms)
retryDelayMs.description: The first retry's delay; each further one doubles it.

logLevel.title: Log level
logLevel.description: Lifecycle lines in the transcript at info; details in the debug log at debug.

agentPolicy.title: Agents at rollover
agentPolicy.description: drain: wait for running agents to finish (up to the drain timeout). record: record them and roll over at once.

agentDrainTimeoutMs.title: Agent drain timeout (ms)
agentDrainTimeoutMs.description: How long a drain waits for running agents before recording them for re-dispatch.

notifyAgents.title: Tell agents to wrap up
notifyAgents.description: Message running agents when the drain starts.

blockNewAgents.title: Hold new agents
blockNewAgents.description: Refuse new Agent spawns from the prepare limit on; the model records the task instead.

autoCommit.title: Auto-commit
autoCommit.description: Commit the working tree before restarting. Never onto protected or detached branches, over conflicts or mid-merge.

protectedBranches.title: Protected branches
protectedBranches.description: Comma-separated branches auto-commit never commits to.

gitSafetyRef.title: Git safety ref
gitSafetyRef.description: Keep a ref (refs/context-rollover/<id>) to a stash-style commit of the working tree; touches neither tree nor index.

resumeOnStartup.title: Unrestored continuation at startup
resumeOnStartup.description: ask: put /rollover resume in the prompt box. auto: restore it. off: only show it.

useModelSummary.title: Targeted model summary
useModelSummary.description: Ask the session's model (a cached fork) for intent, decisions and next steps the repository cannot hold.

notifyModel.title: Tell the model
notifyModel.description: Tell the model when the soft and prepare limits pass.

staleAfterHours.title: Stale after (hours)
staleAfterHours.description: A continuation older than this is no longer offered.
